name: Hai Phong Museum
kicker: City museum on Điện Biên Phủ
summary: Walk the city museum at 66 Điện Biên Phủ and see the rooms on the port's history. About 19,000 objects are kept here, including Cái Bèo tools dated 6,000 to 7,000 years. Twelve permanent rooms and one thematic room cover prehistory, the old port, and maritime heritage. A ticket and the gate hours are Check on arrival.
getThere: 66 Điện Biên Phủ, a walk in the center.
heroCaption: The red museum front behind the iron fence
gettingThere: The museum is at 66 Điện Biên Phủ, phường Hồng Bàng. It sits on the center walk with the opera square. Minutes from the square are Check on arrival.
